# Hitesh Rana

> Backend engineer at Mercari building backend systems and developer tools, mostly in Go.

Source: https://hitesh22rana.github.io/

## About

I build backend systems and developer tools, mostly in Go. Currently at Mercari , working on fraud and risk systems.
I'm interested in distributed systems, database internals, and making software easier to operate. Outside work, I tend to build things around scheduling, messaging, and the tools I wish I had.

## Projects

- [chronoverse](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/chronoverse): A distributed job scheduler and orchestrator for your own infrastructure. Supports 10,000+ concurrent executions with 99.9% reliability, using durable job leases, idempotency keys, and a transactional outbox for failure recovery.
  Stack: Go · gRPC · Kafka · PostgreSQL · Redis · Kubernetes · Docker · ClickHouse · Meilisearch · Next.js
- [jsonlogic2sql](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/jsonlogic2sql): A JsonLogic-to-SQL transpiler supporting BigQuery, Spanner, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, and ClickHouse. Used in production at Mercari for historical rule simulation, cutting pre-release validation effort by 80%.
  Stack: Go · JsonLogic · SQL
- [mq](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/mq): A pull-based gRPC message broker with batched reads, write-ahead logging, and consumer-controlled backpressure.
  Stack: Go · gRPC · Protocol Buffers
- [sourcecollector](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/sourcecollector): A small CLI that bundles source files into one text file to share codebase context with AI tools.
  Stack: Go · Cobra
- [soundscripter](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/SoundScripter): Automates audio and video transcription through a distributed workflow.
  Stack: Python · FastAPI · Celery · RabbitMQ · Whisper

### Open source

- Added [interval-based syncing to rosedblabs/wal](https://github.com/rosedblabs/wal/pull/44) (merged).
- Reported [an mTLS handshake failure between the Go SDK and Meilisearch](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch-go/issues/719) ([server report](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5898)).
- Proposed [a single-image SigNoz setup](https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz/issues/7107) for quick testing.

## Work, so far

### Mercari

#### Software Engineer II

Dec 2025 - present | Bengaluru, India

- Worked on the production fraud and risk rule engine at peak traffic of 10,000 payments and 1.5 million rule evaluations per minute. Implemented dynamic JsonLogic evaluation, on-demand feature fetching, dry runs, and explainable decisions.
- Expanded the engine to multi-tenant item-risk detection, supporting 1,000 listings and up to 2 million category-filtered rule evaluations per minute.
- Built jsonlogic2sql, now used in production for historical rule simulation in BigQuery, reducing pre-release validation effort by 80%.
- Built scheduled Dataflow ETL and BigQuery jobs for risk data pipelines, supporting online decisions and offline analytics alongside Flink and Cloud Spanner.
- Delivered real-time Rule Analytics across 200+ active rules. Established POS terminal data as a warehouse source of truth, eliminating duplicate data handling across 5+ services.

#### Software Engineer I

Oct 2024 - Nov 2025 | Tokyo, Japan

- Architected high-volume asynchronous order-cancellation processing, cutting latency by 40%, preventing duplicate operations, and saving ¥7.4 million per month through improved fraud detection.
- Optimized a high-traffic microservice with caching, reducing database query load by 85% and saving $40,000 per month in cloud infrastructure costs.
- Owned an internal real-time abuse risk scoring service from development through delivery, maintaining p99 latency under 100 ms. Automated investigation workflows, saving analysts up to 5 minutes per case.
- Consolidated and decommissioned anti-fraud rules in Flink deployments, reducing infrastructure costs by 30% while improving reliability.

#### Software Engineer Intern

Feb - Apr 2024 | Tokyo, Japan

- Migrated legacy Spinnaker pipelines to GitOps with Argo CD, Flux, and Tekton, reducing deployment time by 40% and accelerating feature delivery across teams.
- Built gRPC-based synchronization to update stale task statuses across distributed services, improving data consistency and reducing process disruptions by 75%.

## AI experiments

Built with AI. Called experiments because “production-ready” is still a hypothesis.

- [aux](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/aux): A shared music queue where friends join a room, request songs, and vote on what plays next. The host's music app handles playback.
  Stack: TypeScript · Next.js · React · SQLite · Redis
- [reachsmith](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/reachsmith): A personal outreach workspace for organizing contacts, drafting reusable messages, suggesting work email patterns, and tracking follow-ups.
  Stack: TypeScript · Next.js · PostgreSQL · Redis · BullMQ
- [surveillance-system](https://github.com/hitesh22rana/surveillance-system): A local-first camera dashboard built on Frigate, with live views, object detection, and manual review of saved snapshots.
  Stack: Python · Frigate · Docker · nginx · PyTorch
